# `csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement`

Space before a semicolon in a for statement.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Sum(int n)
    {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            total += i;
        }
        return total;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement = true`

```editorconfig
csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Sum(int n)
    {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0 ; i < n ; i++)
        {
            total += i;
        }
        return total;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement = false`

```editorconfig
csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
